title: Neuron features beat features that copy no neuron in all four layers, but no layer clears both bars
subtitle: GPT-2 small, public transcoders, layers 8 to 11. Each nudge to the MLP layer's input switches one feature off. We compare the transcoder's change in the logit of the true next word with the real MLP layer's change.
panelA: Agreement (R²) per layer and feature group
panelA_note: 1 = the transcoder predicts the real MLP layer exactly, 0 = no better than always guessing the average, below 0 = worse. Line: 95% interval over features. Values below −1 sit at −1 with an arrow.
panelB: Does copying one neuron predict a feature's miss?
panelB_note: One dot per feature, all four layers. Miss = median over its nudges of |real − transcoder| / (|real| + |transcoder|): 0 = exact, 1 = wrong sign or size. Dots at 1: the transcoder got the sign or size wrong on most of that feature's nudges. Line: median per 0.1 of cosine.
note: Neuron features: cosine 0.9 or more to one neuron, on input and output. Halfway: 0.5 to 0.9. Copy no neuron: under 0.5. 300 features per group and layer (3 draws of 100), up to 8 nudges each, held-out Pile text.
